Manage users

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/Account-Management/User-Management](https://docs.bronto.io/Account-Management/User-Management)
:::

```sh
bronto users <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto users create`](/reference/commands/users/#bronto-users-create) | Create a user |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto users create

Create a user

```sh
bronto users create [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--field` | `-f` | stringArray |  | key=value pair for the request body (repeatable) |
| `--input` |  | string |  | request body from file, or - for stdin |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto users create -f name=x -f limit=10
bronto users create --input body.json
```
